title: Seed
description: The seed, seed.json: the global recovery and the exercises of the default configuration a new database receives. Every text shown (names of exercises, units) is written in each language (text); ids and numbers are written once. Its definitions of texts, ids and limits are shared with the catalog (src-tauri/catalog/schema.json). It mirrors the configuration read by the backend (app/config/mod.rs) and the limits of its validation (app/config/validation.rs); the backend tests check that it follows their fields, required fields and limits.

recovery.description: Recovery after each exercise, in seconds.

languages.description: A value per language of the interface: a new language is added here, then in every text and unit of the seed and the catalog.
